parsed.explanation: Combined regime is the national birth-sex detention rule applied unchanged on the island, with no local variation or mitigation documented. The operative exposure is tier-1 custody placement by legal sex with serious persistent violations in 2021, and no documented effective remedy. No presentation offence, bathroom ban, border restriction, street targeting, or hospital rule is documented, and penal-code discrimination ground plus resident gender-recognition reform are climate signals only for a visitor. Thin data on entry, facilities and care does not offset the documented custody exposure.

entry_documents.interaction: No documented border or document rule interacts with custody exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: trans women imprisoned by legal-sex assignment; 2021 watchdog found serious persistent violations against transgender detainees, applicable here.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No effective custody remedy documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any visitor detained for any reason faces birth-sex placement, converting detention into the documented violation risk.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No bathroom, hospital-ward or public-facility rule documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Unknown whether facility or ward practice differs from custody rule; cannot assume safety.

care_services.exposure: Not documented. No emergency-care, medication or ward-placement evidence.
care_services.interaction: Not documented; detention violations do not establish care access.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: State imposes legal-sex classification for imprisonment; no presentation offence documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Penal-code discrimination ground on sexual identity enabling prosecution of transphobia is documented nationally.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: General prosecution ground does not cancel birth-sex custody as the operative state rule.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No age-dependent rule for minors or guardians documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented interaction; a minor accompanying an adult has no distinct documented exposure or protection.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented. No organised targeting, police sweeps or violence pattern documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Penal discrimination ground is a theoretical recourse; no operating visitor case documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Silence in a thin dossier is not evidence of street safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Persistent detention violations documented in 2021 without documented correction; entry, facilities, care, street and minors factors remain unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Resident gender-recognition facilitation and marriage equality are climate signals only, not visitor remedies.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Oversight findings corroborate unremedied custody exposure rather than mitigating it.

anchor_checks.comparison: Closest: birth-sex detention with repeated violations and oversight without remedy, no presentation offence, other services largely normal. This case matches that tier, without documented hospital or bathroom extension.
Lower: adds birth-sex hospital placement as well as detention and repeated ward harassment. Hospital exposure is not documented here, so this case sits above 0.35.
Higher: no universal birth-sex custody rule, working service remedies and convictions. Documented birth-sex imprisonment here precludes 0.65 despite anti-discrimination ground.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one operative system: national law unchanged on the island. Its documented harm is concentrated in custody, where legal-sex placement and persistent serious violations make state custody the decisive exposure, with no documented remedy changing outcomes. Daily-life, border, facility, care and street factors are undocumented rather than proven safe, but no additional universal rule is documented. Penal-code discrimination protection is a limited positive signal, insufficient to lift the unremedied tier-1 custody rule into reduced risk.
